title: Data-Scarce, Multi-Granular, Multimodal: Benchmark Design for Biosynthetic Gene Clusters
abstract: arXiv:2611.02275v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) are co-located genes that encode the biosynthesis of specialized metabolites, an important source of antibiotics, anticancer agents, immunosuppressants, and agricultural bioactives. Deep learning, particularly self-supervised foundation models, has spurred interest in BGC sequence modeling, but evaluation has lagged behind: existing benchmarks often rely on coarse classification over small curated datasets, providing limited discrimination among models and insight into downstream utility. We propose a benchmark-design framework in which an informative benchmark should be discriminative, separating models with statistical confidence, and applicable, spanning scientifically meaningful tasks under different levels of generalization. We instantiate this framework as BGC-Bench, which derives five tasks from MIBiG, ranging from A-domain substrate prediction to BGC-molecule retrieval, evaluates them under g

translated_title: 数据稀缺、多粒度、多模态：生物合成基因簇的基准设计
translated_abstract: 生物合成基因簇（BGCs）是一组共定位的基因，负责编码特定代谢物的生物合成，这些代谢物是抗生素、抗癌药物、免疫抑制剂和农业生物活性物质的重要来源。深度学习，尤其是自监督基础模型，激发了对BGC序列建模的浓厚兴趣，但相关评估却相对滞后：现有基准通常依赖于小型精选数据集上的粗粒度分类任务，对模型之间差异的区分能力有限，对下游实用价值的洞察也不足。我们提出了一个基准设计框架，认为一个有价值的基准应当具有区分性——能够以统计置信度区分不同模型——以及适用性——涵盖不同泛化层次下具有科学意义的任务。我们将该框架实例化为BGC-Bench，该基准从MIBiG数据库中衍生出五个任务，范围从A结构域底物预测到BGC-分子检索，并在（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个以区分性和适用性为核心的基准设计框架，并实例化为BGC-Bench，通过从MIBiG衍生的五个多粒度、多模态任务（从A结构域底物预测到BGC-分子检索），弥补了生物合成基因簇深度学习研究中评估方法滞后于模型发展的不足。
en_tdlr: We propose a benchmark-design framework emphasizing discriminative power and applicability, instantiated as BGC-Bench with five multi-granular, multimodal tasks derived from MIBiG (from A-domain substrate prediction to BGC-molecule retrieval), addressing the lagging evaluation in deep learning for biosynthetic gene clusters.
